dataIdInfo.idPurp:
CNMI Joint Military Training (CJMT) RDEIS/OEIS Master GIS Database. VERSION 2
This database was developed in 2022-2023 using the Navy GeoReadiness Data Model (NDM) version 4.3 and the USMC GeoFedlis Data Model (GDM) 4.0.5 and includes data carried over and converted from previous CJMT data.
The data included in this database is in support of the CJMT Revised EIS being conducted from 2022 to 2023. Database updates will be provided at desinated times during the EIS process to incorporate changes in data or new data as the project proceeds.
CJMT Version 1 & 2 databases should be considered preliminary and may not include all features for proposed actions (e.g, detailed base camp) and may not include data used in the previous CJMT EIS, due to changes to the proposed action and planning. (DO NOT ASSUME OLD CJMT DATA IS STILL VALID).
The A-E shall provide environmental planning services for a National Environmental Policy Act Record of Decision (ROD). The A-E shall prepare the Commonwealth of the Northern Mariana Islands (CNMI) Joint Military Training (CJMT) Revised Draft (EIS)/ Overseas Environmental Impact Statement (OEIS) and Final EIS/OEIS to assess the potential environmental impacts of the revised action alternatives on Tinian Island in the CNMI. Effort will include all associated surveys, studies, interviews, public meetings, coordination, and documentation, and documentation to support Federal consultations. Because the EIS/OEIS is an interdisciplinary document containing interdependent evaluations, the A-E shall coordinate information across all subject matter to avoid inconsistencies. All work shall be in accordance with the National Environmental Policy Act (NEPA), Federal laws, and applicable Navy and Marine Corps policies and instructions.

CJMT Road Centerlines.

This feature layer includes a combination of existing paved and unpaved roads, limited use agricultural roads, and historic roads that have been long abandonded. It also includes CJMT proposed roads. Please refer to attribute table and queries to display the roads with the correct data.

CNMI Joint Military Training RDEIS GIS Database, VERSION 2, DOPAA CNMI Version (Post Draft Release)

Existing and proposed roads on Tinian. This includes data from 1940s historic map, 2002 USGS map and data, updates made during previous CJMT site visits, and new roads identfied during the Sept 2022 Workshop and subsequent RFIs and adjustments.

Definition: The center of a roadway, as measured from the edge of the navigable road with the paved or unpaved surface.

This entity is supported by the following policy directives and/or indirect drivers: DoDI 4165.14, Presidential Policy Directive #21, DoDD 3020.40, DoDI 5120.04. Copied from parent model [SDSFIE 3.1 Gold]. Decisions made at Transportation SME meeting on October 3, 2014. Verified that entity is required by two or more Components and therefore was added to 4.0 Gold.
